audience: developers and engineering leads who track test coverage with Codecov

useCases.title: Check the current coverage of a repository
useCases.text: Reads a repository and its coverage totals for the default branch head or a commit you name. Also gives per-file totals, so you can see which files pull the number down.

useCases.title: See if coverage went up or down over time
useCases.text: Reads the coverage trend of a repository, grouped by an interval you choose, and summarizes the change. A single flag can be checked the same way.

useCases.title: Find which files changed coverage in a pull request
useCases.text: Compares the base and head commits of a pull request and lists the files whose coverage changed, with the overall comparison.

useCases.title: Find poorly covered files and their uncovered lines
useCases.text: Reads the report tree or full report with per-file coverage, picks the weakest files, and shows line-by-line coverage for one file.

useCases.title: Compare coverage by flag and component
useCases.text: Lists a repository's components with their coverage and its flags, and reads the coverage trend of one flag, so you can see which part is least tested.

useCases.title: Find failing or slow tests
useCases.text: Lists test-analytics results of a repository, filtered by branch, commit, outcome and duration, and summarizes the failures.
